extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset of 13.7k Arabic book pages paired with their Markdown representations, created using HTML scraped from the Hindawi website.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: These pairs were generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML scraped from the Hindawi website
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The arabic-img2md dataset, derived from Hindawi’s web content, may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: This dataset was exclusively used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat.
